title: 🎉Let's celebrate our 16th birthday together!🎁
content:
## _Guess what day it is today?_

## _It's CLO Virtual Fashion's 16th birthday! 🎉_

![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/f53f9297767049c29842c7c8cd40b43c/images/71482d3214634a8ba83bac40f7843cb4IMG_5936.jpg)

We're having a small celebration at the office, and we are happy to share this special moment with all of you. Over the past 16 years, we've grown and achieved so much, and it's all thanks to your incredible support and enthusiasm.

![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/f53f9297767049c29842c7c8cd40b43c/images/a44d661fa93c403eb8718661c4937e74IMG_0173.jpg)

From our humble beginnings to becoming a leader in virtual fashion, your trust and loyalty have been the driving force behind our success. We are deeply grateful for each and every one of you who has been part of this journey.

## _As we celebrate this milestone, we look forward to many more joyful and innovative years ahead. We can't wait to continue this exciting journey with you, filled with new adventures, creativity, and shared successes._

Thank you for being with us, and here's to a bright and marvelous future together! 🌟

title: ✨Have you heard of the #MyDigitalCloset challenge?
content:
We’re currently running a really cool challenge, and the experience has been so fun and special!

The theme of the challenge,**#MyDigitalCloset** , invites participants to combine their items with CONNECT’s motion to tell unique stories in their own digital spaces.

So far, this challenge has had two rounds, and the submissions we’ve received have been truly moving. From stunning outfits to creative concepts, the entries are brimming with passion, energy, and originality.

* * *

We’re excited to share the highlight videos from Round 1 and Round 2 with you.

These videos are being shared through our Instagram([@closet_connect_official](https://www.instagram.com/closet_connect_official/)) and community channels, and they’ve also received great feedback and brought a lot of joy within CLO.

![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/5266c10158e14383825d34f1c4e49346/images/34c12928acfb45af8fb7ca31e7b2ba41challenge.png)

Even if your work didn’t make it into the highlight video, your participation was an important part of what made this challenge so special.

* * *

# **_Did you miss out on the first two rounds? Don’t worry!_**

**The 3rd challenge is coming soon, and it’s going to be even more exciting and thrilling—so stay tuned!**

We sincerely thank everyone who took part in **#MyDigitalCloset** challenge, and every moment we shared through it was truly precious. Don’t worry if you missed out this time; there will be plenty more opportunities coming your way. We look forward to seeing even more creative challenges ahead!

Plus, if you have any challenge ideas you’d love to see, feel free to share them in the comments!

**_Let’s enjoy this challenge together!🎉🎀_**

  


![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/5266c10158e14383825d34f1c4e49346/images/f647f4f6604d47478168a602756ef5db%EC%8B%9C%ED%80%80%EC%8A%A4%2002_reel.00_00_02_20.%EC%8A%A4%ED%8B%B8%20001.png)

title: How to export to USD without Garment looking messed up?
content:
Hello, I'm trying to use the Marvelous Designer USD to Unreal Engine Chaos Cloth workflow for various garments I have acquired on Connect and fitted to MetaHumans. The problem is every single USD I export looks really messed up with strange opacities and flat colors.   
  
I made this video to clarify what is happening. (Yes, I know I did not properly UV pack in the video, rest assured I've had many attempts with UV packing)  


  
  
I've been working with Tech Support for the past month, but I still don't have a solution to this. I've seen a couple others bring up this issue, yet there is no solution is sight. From what I understand, some people are _not_ having this issue, so I'm confused on why that would be. Thank you for your time reading all this.
content_description: This web page aims to share insights and seek solutions for issues encountered when exporting garments from Marvelous Designer to Unreal Engine using the USD workflow, particularly concerning opacity and color discrepancies.

title: #whatsonmydesk
content:
Hey everyone!

I'm excited to kick off our "What's on my desk?" event by sharing my own workspace setup. 😊

![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/6599963c56df44ce914f35161f6cae05/images/e1d7c88e259740b38b1e9d21b4e67aceIMG_0079.jpg)

On my desk, you'll see the community and a software screen displayed. (and yes, I'm Marvelous Designer user!🙌)

I also like to arrange my monitor and laptop vertically, one above the other. This setup helps me maximize my workspace and keep everything in view without having to turn my head too much.

![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/6599963c56df44ce914f35161f6cae05/images/9557d8e19e2c439c9f374e097d788f8cIMG_0078.jpg)

![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/6599963c56df44ce914f35161f6cae05/images/8a871e76800242e28b24424f97fab417IMG_0080.jpg)

I'm also showcasing my favorite 2-in-1 charging station and my trusty tea strainer. These items help keep me organized and energized throughout the day.

A little story about my tea strainer: I got it during a trip to a local market, and it's been my companion ever since. It reminds me to take small breaks and enjoy a cup of tea, which really helps me stay focused and relaxed🫧

Can't wait to see what your desks look like! Let's share and get inspired by each other's setups.💫


### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: I love the Marvelous Pin + the Charging Station :)
Reply 1: They are my source of energy!🔥🔥⚡⚡

Comment 2: those cute & useful items on the desk can bring a sense of happiness 😃😃😃
Reply 1: Thank you for the sweet words! Looking forward to see yours too😍
content_description: Join our "What's on my desk?" event to share and explore inspiring workspace setups while maximizing productivity and creativity together!
